result.reason: The grant adds Affiliates, contractors, an uncured-material-breach standard, and M&A successor transferability, but unrevised provisions directly defeat those changes: clause (e) prohibits access by anyone other than Licensee employees, and Article IV permits immediate termination for any breach, retains a fixed term, and makes renewal subject to Licensor's option or mutual agreement. It also does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable. Removing “solely” from the Field-of-Use limitation is unnecessary. The conflicting operative terms make the redline internally inconsistent and professionally deficient; the margin comment does not cure them.
